<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for all review comments with AI agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the
rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

Inline comments:
In `@main-packages-list.ocp`:
- Around line 23-25: Move the Hatch backend RPMs out of main-packages-list.ocp
and into build-packages-list.ocp so build-wheels-ocp.sh can install them during
wheel generation. Update the package lists to place
python3.12-hatch-fancy-pypi-readme, python3.12-hatch-vcs, and
python3.12-hatchling in the build-time list, since the build flow uses
build-packages-list.ocp with pip --no-build-isolation. Verify the package
placement by checking the package list files rather than changing the wheel
build script.

In `@requirements.cachito`:
- Around line 21-55: The offline dependency inputs are incomplete for
requests===2.32.5 because its transitive wheels are not declared. Update the
dependency lists used by build-wheels-ocp.sh and prepare-image.sh by adding
urllib3 and idna alongside the existing direct packages in requirements.cachito
and main-packages-list.ocp, so the no-deps/no-index workflow can install
requests without relying on undeclared transitive downloads.
```
